name: synergieloc
description: Buildings and real-estate tools for Grok Build, through the hosted Synergieloc MCP server: describe a building in JSON and get a checked scene, dimensioned DXF, IFC 4 model, BIM rule checks, quantities, cost estimates and a 4K walkthrough, checked against the code of the declared country (France, EU, US, UK, Germany, China); plus French building-permit drafts and French rental management (IRL rent review, service-charge settlement, rent receipts) with their legal basis.
